newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse index eases in cautious trading.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse index eases in cautious trading.

text.p: The Nairobi 20-share index eased marginally in higher turnover on Wednesday as traders moved cautiously in the wake of poor results announced by Diamond Trust Bank Kenya.
The 20-share index shed 0.83 points to close at 3310.92.
Turnover stood at 28.034 million shillings on 568,161 shares compared to 8.178 million shillings on 203,760 shares on Tuesday.
Diamond Trust Bank posted after tax losses of 91 million shillings ($1.6 million) for the year ended December 31, 1996 against a 284 million shilling profit in 1995.
Operating profit stood at 268 million shillings in 1996 against 427 million shillings the previous year.
The bank's chairman, Zaher Ahmed, blamed poor lending decisions which led to unacceptable bad debt levels for the results.
"Last week, some traders held onto their Diamond Trust shares because the thought they just might release a profit, however small," a bourse official said.
"Now, everyone is trading cautiously. They're watching to see how much further prices will slip," a broker said.
Diamond Trust shares lost 8.00 shillings on Monday to close at 22.25. No deals in the shares were recorded on Wednesday.
Kenya Commercial Bank held steady. It was the most actively traded share at a reserve price of 96.50 and 97.00 compared to 95.50 on the one-hour special board.
Market analysts said the Easter lull was expected to dampen the market until speculative buying revives interest as companies publish results towards the middle of the year.
"What's going to happen is that most prices will lose a few shillings once registers close," a senior broker said.
Barclays Bank was unchanged at 100.00 while Standard Chartered Bank shed 50 cents to close at 46.25.
Rea Vipingo closed at 9.00 unchanged while Brooke Bond eased to 132.00 from 135.00.
Foreigners bought 30,600 shares of Sasini Tea & Coffee at between 77.00-78.00 from 76.00 and 8,900 shares of Uchumi at between 36.50-36.75 from 36.25.
